facts.value: These courses aim to convey communicative and intercultural foreign language skills and to refresh and complete existing basic knowledge in the English language.
Three levels are offered: A2/B1, B1, and B2.1.
Completion of level A2/B1 of the GER or 26 – 40 points in the placement test.
It is recommended to take the placement test before registration to ensure correct course placement.

In the Business English Foundation course, vocabulary and expressions specific to the business world are taught. A variety of exercises aim to promote linguistic and conceptual understanding of current topics and provide a basis for discussions and written exercises on various economic subjects. The reading and writing component of the course is assessed in a 90-minute written exam in the last week of the semester.
A graded certificate is issued for passing the exam.
The number of participants is limited to a maximum of 20 in all courses.
Unit 1 – What is Economics?; Unit 2 – Economic Indicators; Unit 3 – Business Cycle; Unit 4 – Retail Banking; Unit 5 – Retail.
90 Euro.
See LSF.
